# String

*JavaScript*

Methods of JavaScript strings. Strings are immutable: methods return new strings and never change the original.

## Methods

### anchor {#anchor}

::: member

Deprecated HTML helper: wraps the string in ``.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | anchor name |

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the HTML string

:::

### at {#at}

::: member

Returns the character at an index; negative indexes count from the end.

```js
'hello'.at(-1); // 'o'
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | position, negative from the end |

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the character, or `undefined` if the index is out of range

:::

### charAt {#charat}

::: member

Returns the character at an index.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | position from 0 |

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the character, or an empty string if the index is out of range

:::

### charCodeAt {#charcodeat}

::: member

Returns the UTF-16 code of the character at an index.

```js
'A'.charCodeAt(0); // 65
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | position from 0 |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — code from 0 to 65535, or `NaN` if the index is out of range

:::

### codePointAt {#codepointat}

::: member

Returns the Unicode code point starting at an index; unlike `charCodeAt`, handles characters outside the basic plane (emoji).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | position from 0 |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the code point, or `undefined` if the index is out of range

:::

### concat {#concat}

::: member

Joins strings to this one. The `+` operator does the same.

:::

### constructor {#constructor}

::: member

The `String` function. `String(value)` converts a value to a string.

### endsWith {#endswith}

::: member

Checks whether the string ends with the given text.

```js
'stone.png'.endsWith('.png'); // true
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `search` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | text to look for |
| `endPosition` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | treat the string as this long; optional |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — `true` if it ends with `search`

:::

### includes {#includes}

::: member

Checks whether the string contains the given text.

```js
'minecraft:stone'.includes('stone'); // true
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `search` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | text to look for |
| `position` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index to start searching from; optional, 0 by default |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — `true` if `search` is found

:::

### indexOf {#indexof}

::: member

Finds the first occurrence of the given text.

```js
'a,b,c'.indexOf(','); // 1
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `search` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | text to look for |
| `position` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index to start searching from; optional, 0 by default |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — index of the first occurrence, or `-1` if not found

:::

### isWellFormed {#iswellformed}

::: member

Checks that the string has no lone UTF-16 surrogates.

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — `true` if the string is valid Unicode

:::

### localeCompare {#localecompare}

::: member

Compares two strings in the sort order of a language; useful for `Array.sort`.

```js
names.sort(function (a, b) { return a.localeCompare(b); });
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `other` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | string to compare with |
| `locales` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | language tag; optional |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — negative if this string goes first, positive if after, 0 if equal

:::

### match {#match}

::: member

Matches the string against a regular expression.

```js
'x=10, y=20'.match(/\d+/g); // ['10', '20']
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `regexp` | `RegExp` | regular expression; a string is converted to one |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — the match with groups, all matches for a `g` regex, or `null` if there is none

:::

### matchAll {#matchall}

::: member

Iterates all matches of a global regular expression, with their groups.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `regexp` | `RegExp` | regular expression with the `g` flag |

**Returns** `Iterator` — iterator of match arrays

:::

### normalize {#normalize}

::: member

Returns the Unicode normalization form of the string.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | `'NFC'`, `'NFD'`, `'NFKC'` or `'NFKD'`; optional, `'NFC'` by default |

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the normalized string

:::

### padEnd {#padend}

::: member

Pads the string at the end up to a length.

```js
'ab'.padEnd(5, '.'); // 'ab...'
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `targetLength` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | length of the result |
| `padString` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | filler; optional, a space by default |

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the padded string

:::

### padStart {#padstart}

::: member

Pads the string at the start up to a length.

```js
String(7).padStart(3, '0'); // '007'
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `targetLength` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | length of the result |
| `padString` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | filler; optional, a space by default |

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the padded string

:::

### repeat {#repeat}

::: member

Repeats the string.

```js
'-'.repeat(5); // '-----'
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | how many times, 0 or more |

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the repeated string

:::

### replace {#replace}

::: member

Replaces the first match of a text, or every match of a global regular expression.

```js
'a-b-c'.replace('-', '+'); // 'a+b-c'
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pattern` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | text or regular expression to find |
| `replacement` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | new text (`$1` inserts a group) or a function returning it |

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the string with replacements

:::

### replaceAll {#replaceall}

::: member

Replaces every match.

```js
'a-b-c'.replaceAll('-', '+'); // 'a+b+c'
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pattern` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | text, or a regular expression with the `g` flag |
| `replacement` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | new text or a function returning it |

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the string with replacements

:::

### search {#search}

::: member

Finds the first match of a regular expression.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `regexp` | `RegExp` | regular expression |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — index of the match, or `-1` if not found

:::

### slice {#slice}

::: member

Extracts a part of the string; negative indexes count from the end.

```js
'minecraft:stone'.slice(10); // 'stone'
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | first index |
| `end` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index after the last character; optional, the end by default |

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the extracted part

:::

### small {#small}

::: member

Deprecated HTML helper: wraps the string in ``.

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the HTML string

:::

### split {#split}

::: member

Splits the string into an array by a separator.

```js
'a,b,c'.split(','); // ['a', 'b', 'c']
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `separator` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | text or regular expression to split by; an empty string splits into characters |
| `limit` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | maximum count of parts; optional |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — the parts

:::

### startsWith {#startswith}

::: member

Checks whether the string starts with the given text.

```js
id.startsWith('minecraft:');
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `search` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | text to look for |
| `position` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index to check from; optional, 0 by default |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — `true` if it starts with `search`

:::

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the extracted part
